findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed multiple containers to be resting in bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, items were removed from hand sink. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no test strips to be available within facility. Discussed with PIC, test strips will be purchased. Ensure test strips are available within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at mop sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

(REPEAT) Observed the test strips available to be chlorine bleach. Quat is being used at the 3 compartment sink. PIC is ordering test strips and Purrell test strips. Follow-up date is 7/27/23.

Discussed quat concentration: 200-400 ppm.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Observed the bar hand sink to be blocked by a dumping colander. Cease practice. Hand sinks are for hand washing only. Hand sink should not be blocked. Hand sink should not be utilized as a dump sink. The 3 compartment sink or another dump sink may be used for that process (such as the “wash” basin of the triple sink). Hand sinks should remain clear and easily available for appropriate hand washing. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the pizza oven tray grates to have a layer of grease build-up, as well as some food splash on the lips. Discussed with PIC. Ensure pizza grates and the tray are cleaned as needed to prevent food splash and debris/grease. The trays that catch food were very clean, however. Inspector will follow-up on 7/21/23.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips for the facility. Facility is utilizing this type of sanitizer in the 3 compartment sinks (bar and back kitchen). Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 7/21/23.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Observed the spray bottle of sanitizer to be general cleaner, not chlorine bleach and/or quaternary ammonium. Quat is being used at the triple sinks. Inspector had lengthy discussion with PIC regarding sanitizer use and concentration levels. Ensure spray bottles contain quaternary ammonium and/or bleach. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Women and men’s hand sinks in both bathrooms need caulked to the wall. No caulking is present between the sinks and walls.
2. Mop sink has moldy caulk around the ground basin and some dry wall is coming away above the basin (likely due to water splash). Sink should be re-caulked and dry wall repaired.
3. The hand sink the back kitchen has wood trim on the left. Trim is showing exposed particle board and paint is coming away. Re-seal with paint and/or clear coat (should be non-absorbent, easily cleanable, smooth).

Discussed repairs with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzle of the soda gun on the west side of the bar is observed with pink slime on the inner surface of the funnel section. PIC was consulted and the item was cleaned/ sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria. 

Quat based sanitizer in the 3 part sink in the bar area did not trigger a noticeable change on the inspector’s test strips. Employee stated that they had been trained to ad a capful of concentration to the sink when making solution. The cap appears to hold an estimated 1 oz. Instructions on the bottle state that an ounce should be added for each gallon of water utilized. Education took place during the inspection and the solution was remade during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
This facility is operating as a medium risk based on their menu. The owner will be making a decision within the week to decide if he will continue with his menu or reduce it.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed no vent on the bar cooler to the south side of the bar. Replace the vent cover.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed both back doors to the facility to have no closers. Provide self closers to both doors.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 1)(REPEAT) Coving trim is missing in the bar area underneath soda boxes and three compartment sink. Provide coving.
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 Floors must be shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of caulk at the handsink in the food prep area. Caulk the handsink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed detergent and sanitizer stored on top of the ice holder in the bar. The chemical was stored in a cabinet away from food during the inspection.
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
